name: template-library-loader
body: Template library loader: resolves the library root from the deck config — the `templates:` path when set (relative to the deck root, or absolute), else the local `templates/`; a configured path never silently falls back and neither resolvable is a templates error (templates-dir-required) — then reads the resolved root via an fs.FS rooted at it, validates it fail-fast in the templates-dir-validation order (library.yaml; layout — only library.yaml, slides/, sections/, themes/, media/ at top level, plus the single permitted inert root entry `AGENTS.md` (library-guide-layout), never parsed, validated, rendered, listed or served, every other unknown top-level entry errors naming the offending entry; per template in `slides/<name>/` and `sections/<name>/`: required files, `template.yaml` well-formed with no `usage:` key, layout parses as standard html/template with the registry's function map, errors file:line-qualified; themes have theme.css; references — theme.css relative url() inside its theme dir, layout src/href inside the resolved library, and every layout `media ""path""` argument relative (no absolute, no `..`) and existing under the resolved root's `media/`, violations file:line-qualified to the layout), assigns each template its kind from its directory, parses each `template.yaml` into the template schema model and registers templates (template-registry) and themes (theme-registry); returns the first templates error path-qualified. Single source for start, templates, gallery and reload. A running session resolves the startup-pinned `templates:` value, so the loader is not used to live-retarget a changed value; the reload pipeline surfaces the restart-required error instead (see solution.component.http-server, template-retarget-requires-restart).
